'''Formmn Badees''' was a young [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Badees dreamed of joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and flying a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] against the Empire. However, he had to settle for working in his older brother's repair facility, but he watched every [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] he could obtain that brought news of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
